generation_inputs.preparation: Exact 32x nearest-neighbour enlargement of native 24x24 PNG, without recolouring or aspect correction.

prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: conservation redraw of a 24x24 Amiga road terrain sprite, for 48x48 and 96x96 game exports.
Input image is the ORIGINAL, exactly enlarged32x. It is the sole authority for all interior colour shapes, placement and values. Redraw THIS exact road bend with very restrained illustrated detail. Keep canvas registration, each stepped boundary, brown shoulder, tiny grey dash, and grass colour patch in place. No smoothing, rotation, recentering, widening or new objects.
The intended change from earlier studies is QUIETER TEXTURE and EXACT ORIGINAL AVERAGE VALUES. Grass should be soft painted colour masses, barely visible blade detail, no stippling, dots, gravel, mottling, crosshatching or clumps. Road nearly smooth matte pavement with almost imperceptible fine grain; soil subdued. Detail contrasts at most a few RGB levels around the original patch colour. No globally darker lighting, shadows or colour grading. Keep original bright saturated olive/yellow greens. Each original colour patch should retain its own mean RGB: grass #778800, #557700, #88aa00, #445500, #334400; road #666666; soil #664422. Do not merge neighbouring patches or invent vegetation.
Retain original road/mark horizontal span seven cells on native rows11..15 and bottom exit x10..14 at row23. Keep original upper contacts(18,4),(19,5),(19,6),(20,7),(21,8). Keep ALL original pale #aaaaaa markings at native(19,6),(18,7),(17,8),(14,12),(13,14),(12,18),(12,19),(12,20), and the dim #888888 mark(13,13) at exactly its own original location and brightness. Marks remain tiny individual cells, not white stripes. Coordinates refer to original24x24 canvas.
Paint a FULLY OPAQUE SQUARE including corners by continuing adjacent terrain outside the old transparent footprint. That exterior will be discarded by the exact original software mask. No visible hex outline, border, inset, matte, text or checkerboard. Preserve original interior pixel layout while gently enriching surfaces within colour regions. Goal: downsample to24x24 should look nearly identical.
cleanup: Generated source retained unchanged as fully opaque square paint, including deliberate material extensions outside native coverage. tools/art-review area-reduces to 96x96, applies repeated original mask, box-reduces to 48x48 and 24x24 with coverage caps. No alpha forcing, matte replacement, display-aspect or world-spacing correction. Exterior paint is discarded by the original mask; raw extra coverage is expected.
review: Original-led study; all native coarse material classes retained, exact output alpha. See docs/art/connected-terrain-pilot.md for native palette/texture diagnostics and tentative isolated-tile scores. Normal-play geometry, adjacent joins and user visual acceptance remain open.
determinism: AI reruns are not assumed deterministic; exports reproduce locally from retained source using tools/art-review.
